recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. If an EBM recommendation or decision-map profile still needs maintenance, handle it in the appropriate EBM IG or external source rather than in base PlanDefinition.
issue_request: FHIR-34015 requested adding 33 elements to PlanDefinition to support an evidence-based recommendation resource/profile. The Applied resolution was Not Persuasive with Modification: use a profile/extensions and an EBM on FHIR IG instead of adding those elements to PlanDefinition.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites application in 536780002c920af0f9be0bc243314cbc4bb5dcbf, but that SHA is not resolvable in the local HL7/fhir repository or GitHub commit API. Local source history shows the applied path was a draft EBMRecommendation profile under ArtifactAssessment, added in cfe8c5e5c12e7cf7ce7f34da2dbc310e6c03d338 and refined in ebd503dc549449cfb9e78fce422dc7c914b69327, rather than new base PlanDefinition elements.
additional_context: FHIR-48393 later removed profiles from the base specification for R6 and explicitly listed EBMRecommendation as already moved to EBM; commit 571498e2b2959573e07980c9117923b42624e3a1 deleted the core EBMRecommendation profile. Current fhir.ini includes PlanDefinition as an active core resource and no active EBMRecommendation profile entry. Confluence records show CDS extensively discussed FHIR-34015 and later EBM Decision Map notes moved recommendation modeling toward ArtifactAssessment/Citation/profile/IG work.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Adding the requested PlanDefinition elements now would contradict both the FHIR-34015 resolution and later core profile-removal context.

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 decision removing profiles from the base specification and noting EBMRecommendation had already moved to EBM.
